THE ORIGIN

From bark to balm.

The heart of Alfurin is a single plant extract – drawn only from the bark of the Indian wood apple tree (Limonia acidissima). See where it comes from.

✓ Clinically tested ✓ Steroid-free ✓ Dermatologist recommended
THE STORY

A plant story, kept simple.

Deep in tropical forests grows the Indian wood apple tree, Limonia acidissima. For Alfurin, only its bark is harvested – carefully removed and taken to the facility, where it becomes a plant extract. That extract is the active heart of this gentle care cream for skin prone to psoriasis. A good story deserves good care – here's how gentle Alfurin is on the skin.

1

The bark

Only the bark of Limonia acidissima is harvested – the tree stays standing.

2

The extract

The bark is pressed into a plant extract – the active heart of the formula.

3

The cream

The extract is blended into a gentle, steroid-free care cream.

SKIN COMPATIBILITY

Gentle on skin — independently checked.

Alfurin's skin compatibility was assessed in an independent, dermatologist-supervised patch test on 50 volunteers, including 25 with a history of allergies. No irritation or reactions were observed, and the cream was classified in the mildest, 'non-irritating' category. Read the full patch test below.

CARE & RESEARCH

Care, backed by careful work.

Alfurin is a 100% plant-based, steroid-free care cream built around a single active – the bark extract of the Indian wood apple. It's made to soothe the look and feel of dryness, flaking and redness on skin prone to psoriasis, as part of a gentle daily routine. Its skin compatibility and everyday use have been looked at under recognised research standards (Declaration of Helsinki, GCP).

Alfurin is a cosmetic product for the care of skin prone to psoriasis. It does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment.
